From \(f(2-t)=f(t)\), set \(t=-k\):
\[
f(k+2)=f(-k)=-f(k).
\]
Thus \(f(k+4)=f(k)\), and each block of 4 consecutive values sums to \(0\).

Also \(f(0)=0\), and taking \(t=0\) gives \(f(2)=f(0)=0\).

Since \(22=5\cdot 4+2\),
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{22} f(k)=\sum_{k=1}^{20} f(k)+f(21)+f(22)=0+f(1)+f(2)=f(1).
\]
Given the sum is \(1\), we get \(f(1)=1\). Since \(\ln e=1\), the answer is
\[
\boxed{1}
\]
